Sep 16, 2026 | Uncategorized
Lebanon, Indiana — September 16, 2026 — The Boone County Board of Commissioners and Boone County Council today unanimously approved the affiliation agreement between Witham Health Services and Parkview Health. The formal vote took place at noon during a joint meeting of the Boone County Board of Commissioners, Boone County Council and Witham Health Services Board of Trustees.
